multi_port_exceptions.backbone: AlphaGenome intrinsically has separate 1D sequence-output and 2D pair-output representations. The upper output lands internally at the output embedder; lower output at transformer pair embeddings. Combining them into one merged node would hide the scientific distinction.

scientific_summary: DNA and species identity feed the multi-scale U-Net/transformer backbone; 1D embeddings predict genomic tracks while pair embeddings predict contact maps.
invariants: Original AlphaGenome only; 1 Mb one-hot DNA and species identity; no added cell-state conditioning.
Encoder selected scales 1 bp then 4 bp then omitted levels terminate at a 128-bp Transformer Tower. Decoder mirrors this back to 1 bp; no further pooling below 128 bp.
Preserve same-scale skips and the separate 128-bp transformer tap into the 1D output embedder.
Transformer pair embeddings bypass the decoder and predict 2D contacts at 2,048 bp.
All eleven output types are grouped correctly by 1-bp/128-bp/2,048-bp resolution.
Splice junction head uses donor–acceptor interactions from 1D features.
Miniature output profiles and matrices are schematic; no empirical values or results.
layout: Compact left input, spacious central multi-scale U, tall genomic readout upper right, compact contact readout lower right. Fine white enclosures and plain serif labels. Title sits within canvas top margin.
typography: Readable Times-like serif body 25–28 px; bold serif section headings 36 px; main title 48 px. Black text; no filled headings or tiny gray notes.

placements.placement: Short symbolic DNA nucleotide row and compact one-hot cells with 1 Mb and human/mouse labels. No biological artwork.

U-shaped convolutional encoder/decoder at selected scales 1 bp and 4 bp, with skipped intermediate scales shown by ellipses. Bottleneck Transformer Tower is 128 bp; do not show any further pooling below 128 bp. Two matched encoder-to-decoder skips. Output embedder receives restored 1-bp decoder features plus a separate 128-bp transformer tap. Pair representation branch from transformer bypasses decoder to 2D contact output.
All eight 1-bp readout types plus histone modification and TF binding at 128 bp; native schematic aligned profile lines with donor–acceptor splice arcs, no measured data.
Native symmetric contact matrix with diagonal plus a few off-diagonal cells at 2,048 bp; no quantitative claims.
